findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 風險因素載明 PayPal 受美國及國際反壟斷／競爭法主管機關審視，可能面臨訴訟、罰款與被迫改變業務做法。
findings.excerpt: We are subject to scrutiny by various government agencies regarding antitrust and competition laws and regulations in the U.S. and internationally, including in connection with proposed or implemented business combinations, acquisitions, investments, partnerships, commercial agreements and business practices.

findings.claim: 英國 FCA 對 PayPal、Visa、Mastercard 展開競爭法調查，涉及 PayPal 數位錢包的資金來源與使用相關合約條款。
findings.source: PYMNTS：PayPal, Visa and Mastercard Face UK Competition Investigation
findings.excerpt: The investigation is to determine whether the three companies engaged in “anti-competitive conduct linked to the funding and usage of PayPal’s digital wallet,” the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) said in a Wednesday (May 6) press release.

findings.claim: PayPal 10-Q（2026Q3）揭露 FTC CID、CFPB CID（PayPal Credit）、德國 Bundeskartellamt 程序與英國調查。

regulatory_antitrust.note: 搜尋摘要顯示：英國 FCA 2026-03 起依 Competition Act 1998 調查 PayPal 與 Visa/Mastercard 合約條款（2026-05-06 公布）；德國 Bundeskartellamt 2023-01 起調查商戶附加費/平價條款；FTC CID（2022-02、2025-08）；CFPB CID（2024-08，PayPal Credit）；DOJ 少數族裔商業計畫和解（非反壟斷）。未見 DOJ/FTC 對 PayPal 的壟斷訴訟或歐盟執委會案。未讀頁面故列 clues。 線索 2 條，程式核實 1 條，1 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
